ideas.pitch: A cyber risk quantification and financial loss estimation platform that aggregates threat intelligence and uses LightGBM to model expected breach costs for cyber insurance underwriting.
ideas.title: ActuarialCyberValue
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best Overall Project In Cybersecurity track directly and aligns with the London Institute of Actuarial Studies focus on risk, uncertainty, and quantitative financial loss estimation.

ideas.pitch: A privacy-preserving credit scoring app utilizing zero-knowledge proofs and alternative data features to assess loan default risk without exposing raw financial documents.
ideas.title: CreditQuant Zero
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous FinTech predictive analytics with zero-knowledge cryptography, mirroring the technical complexity of winning engineering projects.

ideas.pitch: An educational data mining tool that analyzes student LMS engagement metrics to predict dropout risk early and automatically generates personalized intervention pathways.
ideas.title: DropOutPredictor Ed
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the EdTech track by applying predictive analytics to student performance and institutional retention metrics, a core theme of the hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An interactive, beautifully designed UI dashboard visualizing threat exposure and simulated financial payouts for corporate cybersecurity insurance portfolios.
ideas.title: CyberRisk UI Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best UI/UX in CyberSecurity track by offering exceptional polish and design quality far beyond typical hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined, real-time transaction monitoring interface designed to flag anomalous credit card patterns and anti-fraud alerts with ultra-low cognitive load for compliance officers.
ideas.title: FinTech FraudGuard UI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aims at the Best UI/UX in FinTech track by focusing on workflow efficiency, sleek data visualization, and immediate operational clarity.
